title: Simple PHP Engine — a PHP 8.5 tutorial in nine chapters (4K)
description:
SPE (Simple PHP Engine) is a progressive PHP 8.5 tutorial: one small web application, built nine times, each chapter adding exactly one idea. No framework, no runtime dependencies — plain modern PHP that people, and AI agents, can read from top to bottom. Every chapter is a strict diff of the one before it, so you can see exactly what each concept costs.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Introduction — what SPE is and why
0:38 Chapter 01 — Simple: a request becomes a page (one anonymous class)
2:37 Chapter 02 — Styled: app shell, dark mode, colour schemes, toasts
4:54 Chapter 03 — Plugins: the request contract (o, m, i, x) and CRUDL plugins
6:54 Chapter 04 — Views: Model returns data, View returns HTML, Theme wraps it
8:56 Chapter 05 — Autoload: the same code as PSR-4 files via Composer
10:39 Chapter 06 — Session: sessions, flash messages, CSRF, POST-only writes
12:23 Chapter 07 — PDO: SQLite, prepared statements, a real CRUDL plugin
14:16 Chapter 08 — Auth: users, password hashing, login/logout, roles
16:12 Chapter 09 — Blog: Markdown content engine, tags, pagination, self-hosted docs
18:26 How this video was made

🐘 PHP 8.5 features along the way: the pipe operator, typed constants, asymmetric visibility private(set), first-class callables, readonly classes, enums with methods, #[\Override], #[\NoDiscard], property hooks, array_first/array_last, the URI extension.

🔗 Links

🎬 How it was made
Generated, not edited. Every scene is one line of JSON (a narration beat plus a visual); the voice is Google Cloud Chirp 3 HD; the screens are a kiosk Firefox driven by geckodriver and captured at native 4K with gpu-screen-recorder; the intro, outro and title cards are HTML/CSS animations rendered frame by frame in headless Chromium; ffmpeg stitched it together, and the whole pipeline was written with Claude Code. The scripts are in the repo under 00-Tutorial/.
